title: London Built New Sewers. Why Did the Waste Still Reach the Thames?
description:
London built an extraordinary sewer network. Its original system still discharged sewage into the Thames.

From Crossness pumping station to the debate over Barking Creek and Sea Reach, follow the engineering choices behind London’s response to the Great Stink—and discover the crucial problem the new sewers did not solve.

00:00 Crossness and the Thames
00:38 London's polluted tidal river
01:09 The Great Stink reaches Parliament
01:37 The battle over the outfall
02:16 Parliament orders construction
02:53 Building the new system
03:44 The problem the sewers did not solve
